name: Grave Ground

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Skeletal hands claw up from a 20-foot square of ground you can see within range (the book lets you arrange four 10-foot squares; the game lays them as one square). It's Difficult Terrain for your enemies. An enemy there when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Strength save once per turn: on a failure it takes 6d6 Necrotic damage and subtracts 1d6 from its damage rolls until the end of its next turn. +1d6 damage per slot level above 5.
